identity.title: Searching for the 380 GHz H<SUB>2</SUB>O emission from the high-z lensed quasi-stellar object MG J0414+0534
identity.journal: Publications of the Astronomical Society of Japan

paper_type_evidence.quote: We report the result of our search for the 380 GHz H$_{2}$O line emissions from the quadruply lensed QSO MG J0104+0534 at z $=$ 2.639 with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA).

evidence.quote: The phase center was $\alpha$ = 04$^{\rm h}$14$^{\rm m}$37$^{\rm s}$.7699, $\delta$ = $+$05$^{\circ}$34$^{\prime}$42$^{\prime\prime}\mkern-1.2mu$.407 (ICRS).

question.value: Can the 380 GHz (and 336 GHz) H2O maser/line emission be detected from the lensed QSO MG J0414+0534 at z=2.639, and what does its flux ratio anomaly imply about its origin?

evidence.quote: In this work, we aim to search for the submillimeter water maser emissions from the lensed quasar MG J0414+0532 with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA).
as part of Cycle 5 (Project ID : 2017.1.00316.S)
The observations of MG J0414+0534 were conducted with ALMA at Band 3 with four execution blocks

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: 4 spws centered 92.396, 93.977, 104.479, 106.081 GHz; spw 27 and 25 0.938 GHz with 1920 channels; spw 23 and 19 2 GHz with 128 channels

evidence.quote: Spw 27 and 25 have a bandwidth of 0.938 GHz with 1920 channels within each band.
Spw 23 and 19 have a bandwidth of 2 GHz with 128 channels in each band.
having rest frequency $\nu_{0}$ of 380.19737 GHz (the 380 GHz line hereafter)
$\nu_{0}$ of 336.22794 GHz (the 336 GHz line hereafter)

arrays.value: 45 antennas in first three executions, 44 in last

evidence.quote: The number of antenna involved in the observations is 45 in the first three executions and 44 in the last execution.
The resulting size of the synthesis beam is 0$^{\prime\prime}\mkern-1.2mu$.64$\times$0$^{\prime\prime}\mkern-1.2mu$.38, with PA of $-$61$^{\circ}$.

sensitivity.value: continuum 1sigma 0.036 mJy; line 0.45 mJy per 0.97708 MHz channel

evidence.quote: The 1$\sigma$ noise per 0.97708 MHz channel is 0.45 mJy.

time_on_source.value: total observing time incl. calibration and overheads 3.96 hours

evidence.quote: The total observing time including calibration and overheads is 3.96 hours.
four execution blocks taken between 2017 December 13 and 2017 December 18

what.value: Magnification factors (13.1 for A1; 27.9 total for A1+A2)

evidence.quote: a magnification factor of 13.1 for the A1 component (see the supplementary information provided by Implellizzeri et al. 2008)

what.value: Lens galaxy G and object X positions from CASTLES

evidence.quote: The positions of the gravitational lenses G and X taken from the CASTLES survey

pipeline_or_manual.value: CASA; flagging then amplitude/bandpass with J0423-0120, phase with J0427+0457

evidence.quote: the amplitude and bandpass calibrations of the visibility data were carried out with the calibrator J0423$-$0120.
we performed self-calibration (phase-only) on the visibility data for all four spectral windows

task.value: CASA tclean; uvcontsub for continuum subtraction

evidence.quote: we conduct continuum and spectral-line imaging with the CASA task $TCLEAN$.

weighting_robust.value: uniform for continuum; natural for line

evidence.quote: we adopt natural weighting for the spectral line imaging to achieve the highest sensitivity for detection.
using channels with frequencies ranging from 104.02$\sim$104.20 GHz and 104.75$\sim$104.95 GHz as the baseline channels.
we do not perform primary beam correction for our images

smoothing.value: Hanning smoothing over 7 channels for spectrum

evidence.quote: after Hanning smoothing over 7 channels is 0.30 mJy
The resulting synthesis beam is 0$^{\prime\prime}\mkern-1.2mu$.35$\times$0$^{\prime\prime}\mkern-1.2mu$.22

analysis_steps.goal: Measure continuum positions, fluxes and spectral index

method.value: Fit elliptical Gaussians to the four lensed spots in uniform-weighted continuum images; fit power law f=f0 nu^alpha

evidence.quote: we fit elliptical Gaussians to these spots.

validation.value: Positions compared with 22 GHz VLA positions

evidence.quote: These positions are consistent with those measured at 22 GHz by Katz, Moore, & Hewitt (1997) with the VLA.

method.value: Continuum-subtract in uv, make MOM0 map between 104.2 and 104.75 GHz, extract spectrum from A1+A2, Gaussian fit

evidence.quote: we integrate the data cube (with continuum removed) along the frequency axis between 104.2 GHz and 104.75 GHz
By fitting a Gaussian profile to the spectrum, we obtained a full width at half maximum (FWHM) of $\sim$290 km s$^{-1}$

validation.value: Argued against residual bandpass via A1/A2 flux ratio, bandpass solutions, and phase calibrator spectra

evidence.quote: by examining the bandpass solutions for different antennas from the calibration process, we do not see a characteristic bandpass shape as seen in Figure 2

analysis_steps.goal: Lens modelling to explain flux ratio anomaly

method.value: SIE(G)+SIS(X)+external shear fit to four image positions and A1, A2 continuum fluxes; multi-clump source model for line

evidence.quote: Our model of SIE(G)+SIS(X)+shear for the system fits well to the observed images and fluxes, with a reduced $\chi^2$ of 1.0.

fitting.value: Priors on G and X centroids from observed light; uniform priors on other parameters

evidence.quote: We adopt a prior on the centroids of G and X based on the observed light distribution (listed in Table 1), and uniform prior on the other parameters.
We performed data reduction of the ALMA data with the Common Astronomy Software Application Package (CASA; McMullin et al. 2007).
We model the lens system with Glee, a lensing software developed by A. Halkola and S. H. Suyu
Averaging these measurements gives a best estimate of $\alpha$ $=$ $-$1.51$\pm$0.02.
we obtained a full width at half maximum (FWHM) of $\sim$290 km s$^{-1}$ (with relativistic correction)
a peak flux of $\sim$0.8 mJy
we get a total isotropic (unlensed) luminosity $L_{\rm H_{2}O}$(380 GHz) of $\sim$5400000 $L_{\odot}$

results_numeric.quantity: A2/A1 flux ratio, line vs continuum

evidence.quote: the flux ratio between the A1 and A2 line component (A2/A1 $=$ 1.2) is different from what we see in the continuum image (A2/A1 $=$ 0.8)

evidence.loc: 3.3 The Non-Detection of the 336 GHz Line
evidence.quote: we can place a 3-$\sigma$ upper limit of the 336 GHz line to be 1.0 mJy

results_numeric.quantity: Lower-limit SFR if SNe explain continuum

evidence.quote: the inferred lower limit of the starformation rate is $\sim$10$^{9}$ $M_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$

findings_qualitative.value: Continuum is likely jet synchrotron; supernovae cannot account for it

evidence.quote: we can conclude that SNe cannot account for the majority of the observed radio emission from MG J0414$+$0534

claims.hypothesis: The 380 GHz H2O line is detectable from MG J0414+0534
claims.experiment: Band 3 ALMA spectral line imaging of spw 25
claims.result: Weak 2-3 sigma broad features, MOM0 emission at A1 and A2

evidence.quote: Our observation shows a tentative detection of the 380 GHz line from the lensed QSO

evidence.loc: 3.3 The Non-Detection of the 336 GHz Line
evidence.quote: no detection can be see in the spectrum

claims.hypothesis: Line flux ratio anomaly arises from spatially displaced emitting regions
claims.experiment: SIE+SIS+shear lens model with multiple source clumps
claims.result: Clumps ~1.5 kpc displaced produce images only in A2
claims.finding: Line emission from two or three locations

evidence.quote: the 380 GHz line emissions come from two or three spatially displaced locations in the QSO

why_this_data.value: 380 GHz back-bone maser line predicted brighter than 22 GHz and redshifted into ALMA Band 3

evidence.quote: the strength of the 380 GHz maser line can be brighter than the 22 GHz one by a factor of 10$-$1000

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Residual bandpass continuum rejected as origin of broad profile

evidence.quote: the residual bandpass should be negligible after averaging the entire dataset

limitations_admitted.value: Detection is tentative and low S/N; line may be partly thermal

evidence.quote: we want to emphasize that our current detection is still tentative.

referee_caveats_inferred: Detection at 2-3 sigma; baseline channels were changed after seeing the data, risking continuum-subtraction artifacts
Lens model with free source clumps is unconstrained by the data
Bandwidth of ~1 GHz barely exceeds line width

data_public_as_stated.value: ALMA project data acknowledged but public status not explicitly stated
